blocks.text: This guide provides the configuration steps needed to begin using Risk360 service in Experience Center for your organization.
To configure Risk360, complete the following steps:

blocks.item: Your organization is enabled with Authentication Service and you must assign Authentication Service users as Risk360 service admins:
Add Risk360 admin role in Experience Center. To learn more, see Adding Risk360 Admin Roles.
Add users in the Authentication Service Admin Portal. To learn more, see Adding Users.
Assign users a Risk360 admin role. To learn more, see Assigning Entitlements to Users and User Groups.
Step 2: Configure Domains for External Attack Surface Analysis
You can add domains to run frequent scans on them to detect vulnerabilities for external attack surfaces. To learn more, see Adding a Domain for External Attack Surface Analysis.
Step 3: Manage Peer Score and Financial Risk Settings

You can customize the parameters used to calculate your industry's peer risk score and your organization's financial exposure. To learn more, see Managing Peer Score Settings and Managing Financial Risk Settings.
Configure rules to trigger alerts when a preset threshold is reached. To learn more, see Configuring an Alert Rule.

blocks.text: After configuring the preceding settings, you can start viewing your organization's risk-related dashboards and insights.
